title: Unit · native selection comparison
scope: Source commits db2a5a1 + 7194315. Real screenshots from isolated iOS27 tests. No iOS18 evidence yet; set-count test interrupted. Full screenshots and raw payload provenance retained. Current native versus retained components, not a fabricated before/after redesign.

groups.name: Shared owner: native and intentional fallback
groups.decision: Real current controls, matching content and capture. The native Picker owns platform appearance; optional and per-item-disabled contracts retain buttons. Crops are from the full catalog screenshot below, not redrawn or historic before images.

groups.name: Preserved onboarding behavior
groups.decision: The screen explicitly defaults to three days; this existing product decision is preserved. Weekdays keep Monday-first calendar IDs, full spoken labels and collision prevention. Selecting Wednesday disables it for the other routine.

groups.name: Verification boundary
groups.decision: Catalog local accessibility3 test passed for selection and bounds, but its environment override is not proof of every UIFont-backed font scaling at system accessibility size. Main owns system Dynamic Type, iOS18, set-count completion, combined-source tests and phone verification. Isolated test bundles were interrupted; individual completed case passes are preserved in logs.
